articles.title: How AI-Powered Demand Sensing Is Transforming Real-Time Supply Chain Planning
articles.summary: AI-powered demand sensing is revolutionizing real-time supply chain planning by shifting organizations from reactive forecasting to proactive, data-driven decision-making. Unlike traditional models that rely heavily on historical data, demand sensing uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to analyze real-time signals such as point-of-sale data, weather patterns, social trends, and market fluctuations. This approach enables companies to detect demand changes almost instantly and adjust supply chain operations accordingly. As a result, businesses can significantly reduce forecast errors, minimize stockouts and overstock situations, and improve overall service levels. The transformation begins with integrating diverse data sources into a unified platform, followed by deploying AI models that continuously learn and refine predictions. articles.title: Why AI Systems Fail Quietly
articles.summary: In late-stage testing of a distributed AI platform, engineers sometimes encounter a perplexing situation: every monitoring dashboard reads “healthy,” yet users report that the system’s decisions are slowly becoming wrong.Engineers are trained to recognize failure in familiar ways: a service crashes, a sensor stops responding, a constraint violation triggers a shutdown. Something breaks, and the system tells you. But a growing class of software failures looks very different. The system keeps running, logs appear normal, and monitoring dashboards stay green. Yet the system’s behavior quietly drifts away from what it was designed to do.This pattern is becoming more common as autonomy spreads across software systems.
